references.text: This reference highlights the emotional continuity in Jacob's and Joseph's relationship; while 46:29 marks the joy of reunion, 50:1 marks the deep expression of sorrow and love at the father's death.
A clear typological parallel where Jacob's reunion with Joseph foreshadows the Father's forgiving love in the parable of the prodigal son.
A thematic parallel in the drama of reconciliation; both Esau-Jacob and Joseph-father show how tears and embraces can heal family rifts.
